recipes.title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
steps: Boil the spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Warm sliced garlic and chili flakes in olive oil.
Toss the drained pasta with the oil, parsley and parmesan.

recipes.title: Cacio e Pepe
steps: Cook the pasta and reserve the cooking water.
Whisk pecorino with pepper and pasta water into a cream.
Toss the pasta through the cheese cream.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles.
Fry garlic in butter, add soy sauce.
Toss noodles in the sauce and top with scallion.

recipes.title: Cheese Omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with salt.
Cook them gently in foaming butter.
Fold cheddar and chives inside and slide onto a plate.

recipes.title: Mushroom Scramble
steps: Fry sliced mushrooms in butter.
Add beaten eggs and cream.
Stir over low heat until softly set.

recipes.title: Shakshuka
steps: Soften onion in oil, add tomato and paprika.
Crack the eggs into the sauce.
Cover and cook until the whites are set.

recipes.title: Soy Ginger Chicken Rice
steps: Sear the chicken skin side down.
Add aromatics, soy sauce and rice with water.
Cover and steam until the rice is tender.

recipes.title: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Scramble eggs in a hot wok and set aside.
Fry chicken and peas, add rice.
Season with soy sauce and fold the eggs back in.

recipes.title: Chicken Pilaf
steps: Brown onion and carrot in butter.
Add chicken, cumin and rice.
Pour in stock and cook covered until absorbed.

recipes.title: Thai Green Curry
steps: Fry the curry paste until fragrant.
Add coconut milk and the chicken.
Finish with lime juice and cilantro.

recipes.title: Peanut Satay Chicken
steps: Blend peanut butter with coconut milk and soy.
Grill the chicken skewers.
Serve with the warm peanut sauce.

recipes.title: Coconut Rice Bowl
steps: Cook the rice in diluted coconut milk.
Poach and shred the chicken.
Assemble with cucumber and cilantro.

recipes.title: Red Lentil Soup
steps: Sweat onion and carrot in olive oil.
Add lentils, cumin and water and simmer until soft.
Blend and sharpen with lemon juice.

recipes.title: Lentil Bolognese
steps: Cook the soffritto.
Add tomato paste and lentils with water.
Simmer until thick and serve over pasta.

recipes.title: Creamy Lentil Dal
steps: Boil lentils with cumin.
Stir in butter and cream.
Season and serve.

recipes.title: Potato Leek Soup
steps: Soften the leeks in butter.
Add potato and stock, simmer until tender.
Blend with cream.

recipes.title: Olive Oil Potato Soup
steps: Cook leek and thyme in olive oil.
Add potato and stock and simmer.
Blend until smooth and drizzle with more oil.

recipes.title: Roasted Potato Wedges
steps: Cut potatoes into wedges.
Toss with oil, thyme and garlic.
Roast until crisp.

recipes.title: Pan Seared Salmon
steps: Salt the fillets and sear skin side down.
Baste with butter and lemon.
Rest briefly and scatter with dill.

recipes.title: Salmon with Asparagus Traybake
steps: Spread asparagus on a tray with oil.
Add salmon and lemon slices.
Roast until the fish flakes.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Salmon
steps: Reduce soy, mirin and sugar to a glaze.
Sear the salmon.
Coat in the glaze and sprinkle sesame.

recipes.title: Egg Rice Bowl
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry an egg until the edges crisp.
Serve over rice with soy sauce and scallion.

recipes.title: Omurice
steps: Fry rice with onion, chicken and ketchup.
Make a thin omelette.
Wrap the rice in the omelette.

recipes.title: Soy Butter Rice
steps: Stir butter and soy into hot rice.
Top with a soft boiled egg.

recipes.title: Pad Thai
steps: Soak the noodles until pliable.
Stir fry shrimp, push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add noodles, sauce and sprouts and toss.

recipes.title: Shrimp Lo Mein
steps: Boil the wheat noodles.
Stir fry shrimp with soy and sesame.
Toss everything with scallion.

recipes.title: Shrimp Rice Noodle Soup
steps: Simmer a quick broth with fish sauce.
Poach the shrimp in it.
Pour over softened noodles and finish with lime.

recipes.title: Beef Stew
steps: Dust the beef with flour and brown it.
Add vegetables, bay leaf and stock.
Simmer slowly until the meat is tender.

recipes.title: Beef Bourguignon
steps: Render bacon and brown the beef.
Deglaze with red wine.
Braise with the vegetables until soft.

recipes.title: Goulash
steps: Caramelise plenty of onion.
Add paprika, tomato paste and beef.
Simmer with potato until thick.

recipes.title: Black Bean Tacos
steps: Fry onion with cumin and add the beans.
Mash lightly and season with lime.
Fill warm tortillas and top with shredded cabbage.

recipes.title: Beef Tacos
steps: Brown the beef with onion and cumin.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill and top with cheddar.

recipes.title: Bean and Cabbage Bowl
steps: Warm the beans.
Dress the cabbage with lime.
Serve over rice with hot sauce.

recipes.title: Spaghetti alle Vongole
steps: Open the clams in wine with garlic.
Cook the spaghetti.
Toss together with parsley and oil.

recipes.title: Tuna Tomato Spaghetti
steps: Simmer crushed tomato with garlic in oil.
Flake in the tuna.
Toss with pasta and basil.

recipes.title: Pomodoro
steps: Cook garlic gently in oil.
Add tomato and reduce.
Toss with the pasta and basil.

recipes.title: Barley Vegetable Soup
steps: Sweat the diced vegetables.
Add barley and stock.
Simmer until the barley is plump.

recipes.title: Minestrone
steps: Cook the soffritto.
Add tomato, beans and stock.
Add pasta near the end.

recipes.title: Cabbage Soup
steps: Soften onion and carrot.
Add shredded cabbage and stock.
Simmer and season generously.

recipes.title: Pork and Pepper Stir Fry
steps: Slice and velvet the pork in cornstarch and soy.
Sear it fast in a hot pan.
Add peppers, onion and garlic and toss to coat.

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Pork
steps: Coat and fry the pork.
Cook the sweet and sour sauce.
Combine with pineapple and peppers.

recipes.title: Pork Rice Bowl
steps: Simmer pork and onion in soy.
Pour over rice.
Top with a soft egg.

recipes.title: Classic Pancakes
steps: Whisk eggs with milk.
Fold in the dry mix.
Fry in butter until golden.

recipes.title: Banana Oat Pancakes
steps: Blend oats, banana and milk into a batter.
Rest it briefly with baking powder and cinnamon.
Cook in buttered pan until bubbles set.

recipes.title: Oat Porridge
steps: Simmer oats in milk.
Stir in sliced banana.
Dust with cinnamon.

recipes.title: Chickpea Salad
steps: Drain the chickpeas and dice the vegetables.
Dress with oil and lemon.
Crumble feta over the top.

recipes.title: Greek Salad
steps: Cut the vegetables coarsely.
Add olives and feta.
Dress and sprinkle oregano.

recipes.title: Lemon Chickpea Mash
steps: Warm chickpeas with garlic in oil.
Mash roughly.
Brighten with lemon.

recipes.title: Zucchini Fritters
steps: Grate and salt the zucchini, then squeeze it dry.
Mix with eggs, flour, parmesan and mint.
Fry spoonfuls in oil until crisp.

recipes.title: Zucchini Gratin
steps: Layer sliced zucchini with cream and garlic.
Top with parmesan and breadcrumbs.
Bake until bubbling.

recipes.title: Zucchini Pasta
steps: Slowly collapse zucchini in oil.
Toss with pasta.
Finish with parmesan and mint.

recipes.title: Chicken Stir Fry
steps: Sear the chicken.
Add vegetables and soy sauce.
Toss until glossy.

recipes.title: Chicken Paprikash Style Skillet
steps: Brown the chicken in olive oil.
Cook onion and pepper with paprika.
Add tomato and simmer until saucy.

recipes.title: Arroz con Pollo
steps: Brown the chicken and set aside.
Fry the sofrito, add rice and paprika.
Return the chicken and cook until the rice absorbs the liquid.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
steps: Caramelise the onions slowly in butter.
Add stock and thyme and simmer.
Top with bread and gruyere and grill.

recipes.title: Garlic Confit
steps: Cover peeled garlic with oil.
Cook very gently until soft.
Season and store in the oil.

recipes.title: Onion Jam
steps: Cook sliced onion in oil until collapsed.
Add sugar and vinegar.
Reduce until jammy.

recipes.title: Tuna Nicoise Style Plate
steps: Boil potatoes and beans separately until just done.
Soft boil the eggs.
Arrange with tuna and dress with oil, lemon and capers.

recipes.title: Tuna Potato Cakes
steps: Mash cooked potato with tuna and egg.
Shape and coat in breadcrumbs.
Fry until golden.

recipes.title: Green Bean Salad
steps: Blanch the beans.
Dress while warm.
Scatter capers and onion.

recipes.title: Miso Ramen
steps: Loosen miso with hot water and garlic to make broth.
Cook the noodles and soft boil the eggs.
Assemble with spinach, egg halves and scallion.

recipes.title: Pork Ramen
steps: Braise the pork belly in soy.
Cook the noodles in the broth.
Top with pork, egg and scallion.

recipes.title: Garlic Sesame Noodles
steps: Boil and drain the noodles.
Toss with garlic oil and soy.
Finish with scallion.

recipes.title: Simple Bolognese
steps: Brown the beef with onion and garlic.
Deglaze with wine, add tomato and oregano.
Simmer long and serve with pasta.

recipes.title: Crispy Tofu with Broccoli
steps: Press the tofu, cube it and dust with cornstarch.
Fry until crisp on all sides.
Stir fry broccoli and garlic, then coat everything in soy.

recipes.title: Mapo Tofu
steps: Fry pork with chili bean paste.
Add tofu cubes and simmer.
Thicken with cornstarch slurry.

recipes.title: Tofu Rice Bowl
steps: Pan fry tofu slices.
Glaze with soy and sesame.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Broccoli Garlic Stir Fry
steps: Blanch the broccoli.
Flash fry with garlic.
Season with soy and sesame.

recipes.title: Tofu Scramble
steps: Crumble the tofu.
Fry with onion, pepper and turmeric.
Season to taste.

recipes.title: Greek Lemon Chicken and Potatoes
steps: Toss chicken and potato wedges with lemon, garlic, oregano and oil.
Roast at high heat.
Baste halfway and finish until the skin crisps.

recipes.title: Honey Mustard Chicken
steps: Whisk honey, mustard and garlic.
Coat the chicken.
Roast until sticky.

recipes.title: Chicken Gyros Bowl
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and paprika.
Grill and slice.
Serve over rice with cucumber dill yogurt.

recipes.title: Chocolate Lava Cakes
steps: Melt chocolate with butter.
Whisk in sugar, eggs, flour and salt.
Bake hot and briefly so the centres stay molten.

recipes.title: Brownies
steps: Melt chocolate and butter.
Beat in sugar and eggs, fold in flour and cocoa.
Bake until the top cracks.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mousse
steps: Melt the chocolate.
Fold in whipped cream and beaten eggs.
Chill until set.

recipes.title: Smashed Cucumber Salad
steps: Smash and salt the cucumbers.
Whisk vinegar, sugar, sesame oil and garlic.
Toss with chili flakes.

recipes.title: Quick Pickled Carrots
steps: Julienne the carrots.
Warm vinegar with sugar and salt.
Pour over and chill.

recipes.title: Cucumber Carrot Slaw
steps: Shred cucumber and carrot.
Dress with sweetened vinegar and garlic.
Rest ten minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Kimchi Fried Rice
steps: Fry chopped kimchi in oil with gochujang.
Add the cold rice and break it up.
Top each portion with a fried egg and scallion.

recipes.title: Bacon Fried Rice
steps: Render the bacon.
Fry rice in the fat.
Fold in scrambled egg and soy.

recipes.title: Kimchi Pancake
steps: Mix kimchi with flour, egg and water.
Fry thin in hot oil.
Cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Rosemary Lamb Chops
steps: Marinate the chops with garlic, rosemary and oil.
Sear hard on both sides and rest.
Squeeze lemon over before serving.

recipes.title: Lamb with Mint Sauce
steps: Grill the chops.
Blend mint with vinegar and sugar.
Serve the sauce alongside.

recipes.title: Smashed Potatoes with Yogurt
steps: Boil then smash the potatoes.
Roast in oil until crisp.
Serve with garlic lemon yogurt.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Carrot Mash
steps: Steam the sweet potato and carrot until very soft.
Mash with butter and a splash of milk.
Season lightly.

recipes.title: Spicy Sweet Potato Wedges
steps: Cut into wedges.
Toss with chili and paprika.
Roast until caramelised.

recipes.title: Chicken Rice Congee
steps: Simmer rice with plenty of water until collapsed.
Poach and shred the chicken into it.
Stir in grated carrot and butter.

recipes.title: Turmeric Quinoa with Chickpeas
steps: Toast quinoa with onion and turmeric in oil.
Add water and cook until fluffy.
Fold in chickpeas and spinach, finish with lemon.

recipes.title: Couscous Chickpea Salad
steps: Hydrate the couscous.
Mix with chickpeas and raisins.
Dress with oil and lemon.

recipes.title: Creamy Spinach Quinoa
steps: Cook the quinoa.
Wilt spinach with cream.
Combine and finish with parmesan.
